title: Generate rent report with valid rental data
gherkin:
Feature: Rent Report Generation
  Scenario: Generate rent report with valid rental data
    Given a rental property with active lease
    When the rent report generation rule is triggered
    Then a rent report should be generated
    And the report should contain rental property details
rationale: Validates that the rent report generation rule successfully creates a report when provided with valid rental data and an active lease.
